description: WP-O5 AI: Codex: Orks (11e) DREADHERDER with an AI decider in the live game. Fixture ork11e_enh_dread_shoot (Dread Mob; the Big Mek with Dreadherder next to the Deff Dread). Both seats go to the AI and the Shooting phase is re-entered, so it begins as an AI Shooting phase (no human auto-selection) and the AI shoots through its atomic SHOOT actions. A selection opens unit_selected_to_shoot synchronously inside the AI's SHOOT, so the AI must answer it without a dialog and without stalling. The scenario waits until the Deff Dread has shot, then checks that the Game Log has the Dreadherder use line for the Deff Dread, that the AI narrated the choice, and that no dialog was shown. Setup privileges: auto wound allocation, the phase re-entry.

steps.script:
AIPlayer.configure({1: "AI", 2: "AI"})
PhaseManager.transition_to_phase(8)
return AIPlayer.enabled and int(GameState.state.meta.phase) == 8
steps.comment: setup: both seats to the AI, then re-enter the Shooting phase so it begins as an AI Shooting phase (no human auto-selection)
the AI's Deff Dread shot (game log)
stop the AI once the evidence is in
the AI used Dreadherder (score 2.0): the use line names the Deff Dread
the Dreadherder re-roll flag sits on the Deff Dread for the rest of the turn

steps.script:
var d = tree.root.get_node_or_null("StratagemDialog")
return d == null or not d.visible
steps.comment: an AI decider never sees the window dialog
view only: scroll the Game Log to the Dreadherder use card for the screenshot (as a player would)
